Introduction
This document sets out the test steps for the generator reverse power protection device for the main generator. The first draft of this document was prepared by Eng. Mahmoud Ahmed Mahmoud at the New Assiut Power Station, Upper Egypt Electricity Production Company; the field test was carried out by Eng. Ali Hussein Farrag and Mahmoud Faisal Mohamed on 9/5/2005.
Safety Precautions
The unit is shut down and the generator is out of service.
Open a work order and provide occupational safety and health category cards.
Fence off the work area and place the appropriate warning signs.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Follow the industrial safety and occupational health instructions for the safety of personnel and equipment.
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
2 No. PHU-100 current and voltage injection sets
2 No. 400/200 V, 1 kVA single-phase transformers
1 No. three-phase switch.
AVO meter (Fluky 87).
2 No. AC V-A current measuring instruments, type YOKOGAWA
Test leads
1 No. Digital Phase Meter (KDK DPF-30N)
1 No. time counter (Time Counter)
Contact cleaning tools (Spray CROWN -8276)
